clue.text: Handled dumped husband for Jack

clue.text: Ensign I teach holds Kindle

clue.text: Imply Madness singer has time to take ecstasy

clue.text: Focus of modern army unit dropping

clue.text: Part of dish that was donated by Adam?

explanation.definitionFit: Spare ribs are pork ribs trimmed of most meat, a familiar dish, and Adam's donated rib was one he had spare.

clue.text: Kitchen equipment associated with drink

taken as written

the first letters of these two words
